summary: Akzo Nobel N.V. filed a 6-K reporting that shareholders at an EGM voted in favor of all resolutions related to its proposed all-share merger with Axalta Coating Systems Ltd., with Axalta shareholders approving at their Special General Meeting. The merger, expected to complete end-2026 or early-2027 pending regulatory approvals, will create a combined coatings leader. AkzoNobel CEO Grégoire Poux-Guillaume will lead the combined entity, with Ben Noteboom as Vice-Chair. No price per share or premium disclosed; watch for regulatory clearance and closing conditions.
